title: US Diplomacy in Asia: Trump, Rubio, and the Quest for Peace
description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio discussed various global conflicts and President Trump's role in promoting peace, notably between India and Pakistan. Despite India's denial of third-party involvement, the US claims significant contributions to peace efforts globally, including in Asia. Rubio underscores the importance of US diplomacy with countries like China and Pakistan.
